586:t_1:88.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But perhaps that is the limit of humanity...」

586:t_1:89.en:
$$フロンタル$$
(So that is how it is, $$シャア・アズナブル$$... and $$バナージ$$...)

586:t_1:90.en:
$$フロンタル$$
(The battle that decides our future, and humanity's at the same time, seems to be coming to an end.)

586:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. As shop owner $$ＡＧ$$ is absent today, we will be running the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ under our caretaker service.」

586:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Furthermore, as for the congratulations to ace pilots, we ask your understanding that they will be held on another occasion.」

586:t_10:7.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I heard the owner is a very amusing person and was looking forward to it, but what a shame.」

586:t_10:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then, Big Sis, I'll take care of that...!」

586:t_10:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's give it our all again toooooday!」

586:t_10:14.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「$$オオタ・カズミ$$... Registration complete.」

586:t_10:16.en:
$n
(Don't tell me... you got caught up in the $$時空震動|lc$$...)

587:t_000:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「I won't let you near the $$アクシズ$$ nozzles!」

587:t_000:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「As expected of you, $$アムロ$$! That's what makes you my rival!」

587:t_000:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Why would a man like you do this!」

587:t_000:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「Humanity, kept like livestock by $$クロノ$$, has no other way to advance to the next stage!」

587:t_000:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's no reason to turn the Earth into a dead planet!」

587:t_001:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「The agony you felt when $$ララァ$$ died! Remember it to the fullest!」

587:t_001:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「You are the one wasting that power! Why can't you see it!」

587:t_001:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Any means will do! Unless the Earth is destroyed once, they will...!」

587:t_001:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't mess with me! Is that what a man who fought alongside us says!」

587:t_001:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「A man who lost to despair and lost sight of the future has no right to drag the Earth down with him!!」

587:t_002:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The front is shifting! All units, follow the $$ラー・カイラム$$!」

587:t_003:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$アクシズ$$! And it's even falling toward the Earth!?」

587:t_003:2.en:
$$メラン$$
「Captain $$ブライト$$! We've confirmed combat at the tip of $$アクシズ$$!」

587:t_003:3.en:
$$メラン$$
「It appears $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and $c are engaged!」

587:t_003:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What's going on!? I'm right here, but there's a $$ダブルエックス$$ out there too!」

587:t_003:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The $$ホワイトドール$$ too...!」

587:t_003:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「That's not all...! There are even $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ units that aren't with $c fighting!」

587:t_003:10.en:
$$勝平$$
「Look! The $$νガンダム$$ is fighting the $$サザビー$$!」

587:t_003:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then the one leading $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is...」

587:t_003:13.en:
$$桂$$
「The battle between $$シャア・アズナブル$$ and $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$...」

587:t_003:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Is this... the beginning of the era that came to be called $$黒歴史$$...!」

587:t_003:15.en:
$$レド$$
「With that asteroid falling to Earth, the world will change completely...」

587:t_003:16.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The wars continue, and at the end the $$月光蝶$$ destroys civilization...」

587:t_003:17.en:
$$レド$$
「And humanity moves out into space with the Moon as its center, seeks places to survive in outer space, and among them the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are born...」

587:t_003:19.en:
$$シャア$$
「...The distorted world $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ spoke of... For me, that was the world where $$アクシズ$$ falls.」

587:t_003:20.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's why I wanted to know. The me in the world where $$アクシズ$$ falls...」

587:t_003:21.en:
$$万丈$$
「And that acted on the $$時空震動|lc$$ and transported $c...」

587:t_003:22.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's the only way to put it.」

587:t_003:23.en:
$$メラン$$
「It seems the $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ on that side can't see us, because of the glare from the $$アクシズ$$ nozzles.」

587:t_003:24.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What do we do, $$ブライト$$?」

587:t_003:26.en:
$$シン$$
「This is no time to hesitate! If $$アクシズ$$ falls, the world will plunge into $$黒歴史$$!」

587:t_003:27.en:
$$シン$$
「Let's fight to stop Colonel $$シャア$$ over there too!」

587:t_003:28.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Wait a second, $$シン$$! If $$黒歴史$$ never happens, what happens to me, $$ロラン$$ and $$レド$$ in the era after it!?」

587:t_003:29.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Does that mean we'd never have existed, and the us standing here now would just vanish!?」

587:t_003:30.en:
$$オルソン$$
「No... Even in that case, it would only cause parallel worlds to diverge. It won't affect us.」

587:t_003:32.en:
$$オルソン$$
「If $$アクシズ$$ doesn't fall in this world, the $$黒歴史$$ derived from it won't occur, and you may never be born in the future.」

587:t_003:33.en:
$$オルソン$$
「But separately from that, the world that went through $$黒歴史$$ will continue to exist as a parallel world. The same goes for you.」

587:t_003:34.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Then there's no problem! Let's hurry up and stop $$アクシズ$$!」

587:t_003:35.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hang in there, me of this world! I'll be there to help you right away!」

587:t_003:36.en:
$$シャア$$
「...But is that truly the right thing to do...」

587:t_003:38.en:
$$甲児$$
「With so many people's lives about to be taken right before our eyes, I can't just stay quiet!」

587:t_003:39.en:
$$アルト$$
「Do you mean to say, like $$フル・フロンタル$$, that the correct history must never be bent!?」

587:t_003:40.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's not it. The question is whether we, foreign elements, are allowed to interfere with this world.」

587:t_003:41.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「In this case, good and evil are not the point. It is a question of whether intervening in history from the standpoint of a god is right or wrong.」

587:t_003:42.en:
$$宗介$$
「If we step in here, is that no different from what $$レナード$$ tried to do...」

587:t_003:43.en:
$$竜馬$$
「True... Where this world is headed isn't something outsiders like us should decide.」

587:t_003:44.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's easy to say, but! Can we even get back to our original world!?」

587:t_003:45.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If we can't get back, then we'd have to live on in this world...」
